about_the_game:
The Story

Journey with Yusol as she strives to rebuild her clan and enact justice against those who destroyed it. Follow her as she pursues the evil Yi Chun and unravels the mysteries of the Heaven's Fall Cult. Along the way, she’ll encounter an expansive cast of heroes, each with their own skills and story, who will join her resurgent clan and unite in the fight to defeat Yi Chun and Heaven’s Fall.

Dual Combat System

Seamlessly switch between turn-based strategy and real-time action.

In turn-based mode, all five team members take the battle field to unite for victory.

For real-time action, one designated lead hero fights the various enemies supported by four skill-linked allies

Character Collection

Build & grow your 5-hero team to begin your journey. With over 40 heroes to unlock, each with their unique skills & stories, a variety of legendary characters awaits you to join your clan.

Visual Style

Immerse yourself in this anime-inspired world with majestic vistas, eerie forests, ancient deserts, and mythical dungeons of the Earthen Realm. Each hero models a distinctive look and feel evocative of the elements.

Deep Tactical Combat

To defeat your foes, master your fighting abilities with a wide array of combinations and skills. With each battle, tailor your team strategically in order to achieve victory across different opponents and environments.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit v1607+
  • Processor: Intel i5-6500 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 3G or AMD Radeon RX 480 8G
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit v1607+
  • Processor: Intel i7-7700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060 6G or AMD Radeon RX 6600 6G
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space

short_description: This thrilling free-to-play Collectible Action MMORPG offers the duality of turn-based strategy & real-time action. Experience exciting cross-platform play and embark on an epic quest where numerous stories are waiting to be discovered alongside your five member team. Unite your heroes!
